user.title: Select Device Type
user.description: Choose your device model or the type of connection it uses.

samsung_2878.title: Device Details (Port 2878)
samsung_2878.description: Enter your air conditioner's information. The MAC address is optional and will be auto-detected if possible. If you don't have a token, leave it blank to start the acquisition process.

rest_api.title: Device Details (REST API)
rest_api.description: Enter the details for your device. The token and device ID must be obtained manually according to your model's documentation.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the device. Please verify the details (IP/Host, Token, etc.) and that the device is online.
error.pairing_init_failed: Failed to put the device in pairing mode. Check the IP address and that the device is online.
error.auth_failed_turned_off: Authentication error (Code 301). Pairing failed. Possible causes: the power button was not pressed in time (~20s) or the AC was already on. Make sure the AC is OFF before starting and turn it ON when prompted.
error.token_acquisition_failed: Failed to get the token. Make sure to press the power button on the unit in time and that the IP is correct.
error.mac_resolve_failed: Could not get the MAC address automatically. Please enter it manually.
error.device_id_required: The device ID is required for this type of configuration.

abort.already_configured: This device (same MAC address or ID) is already configured.
abort.not_implemented: This device type is not yet implemented.

progress.awaiting_button_press: Waiting for user... Please press the power button on the air conditioner unit at **{ip_address}**. You have about 20 seconds to complete this action before the device cancels the process.

common.deprecated_yaml_message: Climate IP configuration via YAML is deprecated and has been imported into the UI. Please remove the `climate_ip` configuration from your `configuration.yaml` file and restart Home Assistant.
